description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and max activation value for different model components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. A dashed orange line, labeled "attn_output", begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to a value of around 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1400 until layer 18, then declines to approximately 400 at layer 24. A dotted yellow line, labeled "attn_residual", starts at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises to a value of around 100 at layer 5, declines to approximately 0 at layer 7, remains near 0 until layer 19, then rises to approximately 400 at layer 24. A dashed green line, labeled "ffn_output", begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to a value of around 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1400 until layer 18, then declines to approximately 400 at layer 24. A solid red line, labeled "ffn_residual", starts at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises to a value of around 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1400 until layer 18, then declines to approximately 400 at layer 24.
